data.title: Arab League Condemns Continued Houthi Militia Attacks on Saudi Arabia
data.content:
Cairo, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The Arab League has expressed its strong condemnation of the continued attacks by the terrorist Houthi militia against the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the latest of which resulted in material damage to one of the KAFD towers in Riyadh.
    In a statement issued today, the Arab League emphasized that the repeated targeting of civilian objects and vital facilities constitutes a dangerous escalation, a blatant violation of the Kingdom's sovereignty and territorial integrity, and a breach of international law, noting that these actions threaten the safety of citizens and residents within the Kingdom.
    The league called for an immediate cessation of these attacks, which jeopardize regional security and stability and undermine efforts aimed at de-escalation and reaching a political settlement to the Yemeni crisis.
    The Arab League reiterated its full solidarity with the Kingdom and its support for the measures taken to protect its security, safeguard its sovereignty, and maintain its territorial integrity, affirming that the security of the Kingdom is an integral part of Arab national security.
    -- SPA
11:00 Local Time 08:00 GMT
